entries.title: AI Intelligence Barrels: Price Wars & Financial Value #shorts
entries.summary: AI providers are pricing "intelligence" wildly differently — the video cites roughly $26 (OpenAI), $56 (Anthropic), and $0.50-$1.50 for xAI/Meta/Google/Chinese labs — framing a coming price war as intelligence becomes a commodity. Figures are asserted without methodology or units, so treat this as a directional claim, not verified pricing.

entries.title: AI Cloud Tool Prices Skyrocket? The Future Revealed! #shorts
entries.summary: This short speculates that cloud AI tools could become expensive, arguing that vendor server/pricing dependency and per-interaction token billing risk becoming a privacy and cost concern. No specific pricing data, tool, or source is cited.

entries.title: What an AI Agent Actually Is
entries.summary: Tech With Tim offers a deflationary, one-sentence definition of an AI agent: a language model that can use tools, running in a loop until it finishes a task. The point is that agents are simpler and less mystical than the hype around them suggests.

entries.summary: A creator shows a Claude skill that solves the lack of a "Google Flights for cruises": given trip dates, it pulls cruise pricing via Apify and cross-checks it against a Google Flights scraper to return the cheapest combined cruise-and-flight option.

entries.title: I Stopped Guessing What To Post And Did This Instead
entries.summary: A creator shares a concrete content-ideation formula: divide a post's views by the median of that same creator's last 20-30 posts, and treat 3x or higher as a real signal across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and X — then rebuild the winning structure in your own voice.

entries.title: Google’s AI mapping project will change how we study the Earth #shorts
entries.summary: Google DeepMind's AlphaEarth compresses global public map and satellite data into 10x10m analysis squares, creating an open AI platform for studying climate, weather, agriculture and environmental patterns at very high spatial precision.

entries.title: Stop Paying for Claude Unlock UNLIMITED Tokens for FREE 🤯 #shorts  #ai #technology #aitutorial
entries.summary: A creator demonstrates OmniRoute, an open-source AI gateway on GitHub that plugs Claude Code into 200+ AI providers (90 free), auto-switching models when Claude's limit is hit and stacking free tiers for roughly 1.6 billion free tokens per month.

entries.title: AI Agents Wrote 55,000 Lines and Built a Real FPS Game
entries.summary: AI builder Matt Shumer directed a fleet of AI coding agents to build "Claude of Duty," a browser-playable FPS with roughly 55,000 lines of code and zero image or audio asset files, since every texture and sound is generated procedurally by code. The open-source project, shared on GitHub, is a striking demo of multi-agent coding output at scale rather than a tutorial.
